content: {"reasoning":"The claim was denied CO-197 for missing prior authorization. This payer offers no retroactive authorization window and no peer-to-peer review, so those paths are closed. Resubmitting as-is or with records would not cure the auth gap and would waste touches. The only proper avenue to progress this denial is a formal appeal arguing medical necessity, which is supported since a denial is on the table.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
